jobs.title: Project Manager, Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description:
This position is remote
; however, preference will be given to candidates located in the Los Angeles/Cudahy area to support occasional onsite collaboration and business needs.

The Project Manager (PM) will lead and oversee the project execution for key accounts across multiple divisions within the Aerospace & Defense business unit. In this role, the PM will own and lead business review(s), stakeholder engagement/management, and partner with operations and commercial leadership to foster continuous improvement and operational excellence. You will ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the exacting quality and compliance standards required by the aerospace and defense industry.

This position requires strong communication and organizational skills, deep knowledge of aerospace quality systems, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers while driving operational excellence and zero-incident safety performance.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Provide leadership, oversight, and day-to-day management of all MISTRAS Aerospace & Defense projects, including NDT/NDI (UT, RT, PT, MT, VT, PAUT, and related advanced methods), access services, and supporting industrial services.
Manage project scope, schedule, resources, budget, and deliverables from planning through closeout; develop and implement planning, cost control, and progress-tracking systems.
Build and sustain strong customer relationships; serve as the primary point of contact for clients, delivering regular status updates, KPI reports, and ensuring 100% customer satisfaction.
Ensure strict adherence to HSE, quality, and regulatory requirements (including applicable aerospace/defense standards such as Nadcap, AS9100, ITAR, and customer-specific procedures).
Lead risk management efforts, resolve field issues and unanticipated complexities promptly, and drive continuous improvement in safety, quality, and efficiency.
Assist with proposal development, scope definition, and budget estimation for new and ongoing Aerospace & Defense projects.
Prepare and deliver accurate daily/weekly status reports, staffing plans, work-location tracking, and performance metrics to both customers and internal leadership.
Demonstrate accessible, visible leadership that promotes positive employee morale, accountability, and adherence to company policies and procedures.

Required Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related technical field preferred.
5+ years of Project Management, with at least 3 years managing Tier 1 or Tier 2 Suppliers (Aerospace & Defense experience strongly preferred).
Solid technical background in testing, inspections, and certifications, preferably within non-destructive test methods.
Prior experience working in regulated industries with strict quality, safety, and compliance requirements (aerospace, defense, or similar highly regulated sectors).
Strong customer relationship and communication skills (written and verbal); proven ability to manage stakeholders and deliver under pressure.
Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional teams with a track record of maintaining exceptional HSE performance and meeting project KPIs.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools; experience with data extraction, KPI reporting, and large worklists/spreadsheets.
Willingness and ability to maintain a strong leadership presence, including travel to customer sites as required.
S. citizenship or ability to meet ITAR and other security/compliance requirements may be necessary depending on specific projects; active or ability to obtain security clearance preferred for certain defense work.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or equivalent project management certification.
API, ASNT, or other relevant NDT certifications.
Experience with aerospace primes, defense contractors, or FAA-related work.
Familiarity with MISTRAS systems or similar asset integrity/project management platforms.

Additional Requirements

Pass pre-employment background check, alcohol/drug screen, and any required medical evaluations.
Maintain relevant certifications and continue professional development as required.
Demonstrate the highest commitment to safety, quality culture, and ethical conduct in all

The salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

Tetra Tech is adding a Federal Project Manager to its High-Performance Building Division’s Operations team. This opportunity is full-time and can be performed remotely or in a hybrid setting if local to one of our offices.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Position Summary

This Project Manager will lead and support business development, data analytics, and the management, design, development, and execution of large-scale military facility projects, including but not limited to administrative buildings, maintenance shops, and training facilities for Air Force, Army, and Navy installations. The position is responsible for managing clients, budgets, and technical execution across multiple concurrent, multi-million-dollar projects with multi-disciplinary teams of architects, engineers, and subconsultants.

Essential Job Functions

Development and execution of a portfolio of projects, including project profitability, quality, safety, client satisfaction, controlling available resources, project scope, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements.
Attend, lead, and contribute to project meetings with project teams, capturing minutes, and tracking actions.
Ensure superior collaboration and communication within a multi-discipline environment between clients, employees, and leadership.
Follow internal governance requirements.
Prepare project tools, including work breakdown structures, risk registers, requests for information, issues registers, and decision logs.
Support the preparation of governance documents, including Project Execution Plans, Quality Assurance Plans, Stakeholder Management Plans, and Risk Management Plans.
Support project change control management.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required
10+ years of experience managing complex projects as a project manager with experience as a DoD PM Proven track record of successfully managing multiple projects and delivering on time and within budget, while meeting or exceeding client expectations.
Demonstrated ability to plan, develop, coordinate, and direct the development of large projects and pursuits with complex features and build key target client accounts.
Ability to motivate others and lead teams to implement plans for projects and client pursuits.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated expertise in data analytics, including advanced use of Microsoft Power BI.
A valid driver's license and clean driving record is required for this position
Ability to obtain a US Government security clearance
Must be a U.S Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree
PMP certification.
Professional Engineer/ Registered Architect
Experience directing and managing large-scale, multi-year enterprise and engineering projects from conception through completion, operationalization, and stability.
Business Development or marketing support experience with capture management, and a background in data analytics.

Work Environment / Environmental Factors

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made.

Work may be performed in-office, remotely, or at project sites.
Fieldwork may include exposure to construction environments, uneven terrain, and weather changes.
Collaboration across multiple disciplines and regional teams is required.
Noise levels differ by assignment, and appropriate hearing protection may be necessary; reasonable accommodation is available to support employees with disabilities.

Physical Requirements

Regularly required to sit and work at a computer for extended periods; occasional standing and walking within the office environment.
Occasionally required to lift/move up to 10 lbs., with infrequent lifting of up to 25 lbs.
Requires use of hands for typing, handling materials, and operating office equipment; vision abilities include close vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
When in the field, must be able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Additional Information

This is a full-time position with the expectation of additional hours, including overtime, as business needs require.
Up to 20% business travel is required, including air and vehicle travel and occasional multi-day trips.
The pay range for this position is between $165,000 to $185,000 annually. However, the pay offered may vary depending on primary work location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal parity

Life At Tetra Tech

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits
Merit-based financial rewards
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

Tetra Tech is adding a Federal Deputy Project Manager to its High-Performance Building Division’s Operations team. This opportunity is full-time and can be performed remotely or in a hybrid setting if local to one of our offices.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

This Deputy Project Manager will lead and support business development, data analytics, and the management, design, development, and execution of large-scale military facility projects, including but not limited to administrative buildings, maintenance shops, and training facilities for Air Force, Army, and Navy installations. We are seeking a skilled Project Manager to join the Connected Care team. The Project Manager is responsible for supporting project activities, solving problems, and escalating risks for support. Excellent interpersonal and client relationship skills

Analytical ability with excellent attention to detail
Excellent risk management skills
Experience leading vendor management and contract negotiations preferred
Strong presentation, writing, and/or training skills
Excellent time-management and organization skills (self-directed)
Excellent team building skills, listening, coaching, group facilitation, and conflict resolution skills
Proficient use of computer, software, and peripheral equipment, i.e., Windows, MS Office, MS Mail/Outlook, MS Project

It is the comprehensiveness of these offerings that makes it a differentiating factor, allowing you to find value where it matters most to you, now and throughout your career at UHN.

Vertiv’s Global Strategic Account (GSA) organization is hiring a Project Manager to lead projects for critical infrastructure and data center projects nationally for our thermal, power, battery, and monitoring products. This person will focus on establishing relationships and processes from pre-sales through equipment commissioning to ensure a smooth repeatable process is established, implemented, and followed. This job requires effective communication with all levels of multiple organizations. This person will also focus on our digital platforms, mainly Oracle, Smartsheet and Power BI which is used to aid in the execution of our business.

Utilize standard Project Management tools to conduct the project effectively, achieving quality, financial and schedule targets.
Define and obtain the appropriate resources required to fulfill the project scope of work. Work with all functional group leaders to develop the project organizational resource chart.
Coordinate with order management, plant production, logistics, contractors, services, and warranty groups throughout the project, escalating potential conflicts to avoid impact to the customer.

Company Description Dominion Forming Inc. is a concrete forming contractor specializing in high-rise residential construction throughout the Greater Toronto Area. We work on complex reinforced concrete structures and are focused on maintaining demanding construction schedules while delivering quality workmanship, safe operations, and reliable performance for our clients.
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Project Manager
to join our team and manage high-rise concrete forming projects from pre-construction through completion.
Role Description The Project Manager will be responsible for the overall coordination and management of assigned high-rise concrete forming projects. This position requires someone who is comfortable working closely with site superintendents, foremen, general contractors, engineers, suppliers, and company management to keep projects on schedule and address issues before they impact production.
This is a full-time position based in Vaughan, Ontario
, with regular attendance at project sites throughout the GTA.
Responsibilities Manage high-rise concrete forming projects from start-up through completion.
Review architectural, structural, and construction drawings and specifications.
Coordinate closely with project superintendents and site teams regarding sequencing, manpower, materials, equipment, and upcoming work.
Monitor project schedules and concrete/formwork cycles to ensure production targets are maintained.
Attend project meetings with general contractors, consultants, and other trades.
Identify drawing conflicts, missing information, and constructability issues.
Prepare and manage RFIs
and follow up until required information is received.
Identify extra work and scope changes and prepare change orders
with supporting documentation.
Track project costs, quantities, labour, materials, and changes against the project budget.
Coordinate material deliveries, forming equipment, cranes, shoring/reshoring requirements, and site logistics.
Coordinate upcoming concrete pours and ensure forming activities are properly sequenced with reinforcing steel, mechanical/electrical embeds, surveying, and other related trades.
Review site progress and identify schedule or cost issues requiring corrective action.
Maintain accurate project records, correspondence, drawings, RFIs, change orders, and supporting documentation.
Assist with inspections, deficiency resolution, and quality-control requirements.
Communicate clearly with clients regarding progress, scheduling, changes, and outstanding issues.
Support company safety requirements and ensure project activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulations and company policies.

Qualifications Previous Project Management or Project Coordinator experience in concrete forming, high-rise concrete construction, or a closely related field
.
Strong understanding of structural and architectural construction drawings.
Experience with high-rise residential construction is strongly preferred.
Knowledge of concrete forming methods, sequencing, shoring/reshoring, concrete pours, and typical high-rise construction cycles is an asset.
Experience preparing and managing RFIs and change orders
.
Strong scheduling, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with field personnel, general contractors, engineers, suppliers, and management.
Good understanding of construction costs, labour productivity, materials, and project documentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with construction project-management and drawing-review software is an asset.
Post-secondary education in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
Valid driver's licence and ability to travel to project sites throughout the GTA.

What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is hands-on, organized, accountable, and proactive
. The successful candidate should be comfortable spending time both in the office and on active construction sites and should be able to recognize potential schedule, drawing, scope, and cost issues before they become problems.
Experience specifically in high-rise concrete forming
will be considered a significant advantage.

Description

You are organized, driven, and thrive in an ownership role
.

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary point of contact and gateway into the studio for a defined set of clients, including Syneos Communications agencies and Syneos Health Clinical departments. Acting as a holistic business partner, the Senior Program Manager ensures the studio delivers on client needs and expectations. This role is accountable for ensuring overall client satisfaction. The Senior Program Manager reports directly to the Director, Program Management.

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for defining project parameters, contributing to creative ideation sessions, and participating in tactical recommendation brainstorming. Once project parameters are aligned between the client and the studio, the Senior Program Manager leads and oversees the project from start to finish, including budget development, timeline creation, and management of deliverable routing. The Senior Program Manager should possess deep knowledge of the creative process and have experience with print production.

This role partners closely with the studio teams and serves as the primary lead for one our internal communication teams, ensuring that work is routed appropriately to necessary stakeholders. The Senior Program Manager ensures that the Creative team is fully integrated into the workflow and redirects relevant projects to them as needed.

Client and Business Management

Serves as the studio’s lead representative, ensuring client expectations are consistently met.
Builds, maintains, and nurtures strong relationships with key stakeholders across disciplines.
Acts as an advocate for the studio by continually building organizational awareness of its value, including coordinating capability presentations, and proactively promoting and recommending studio services as appropriate.
Handles challenges professionally and navigates disagreements diplomatically to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
Represents the studio in new business opportunities.
Acts as the primary escalation point for quality issues, workflow gaps, or performance concerns, and partners with studio leadership to address concerns related to studio performance, personnel, or potential client issues.
Responsible for hiring, training, and managing a team of direct reports, including conducting annual performance reviews and supporting career development.

Intake

Serves as the gatekeeper for all incoming projects, ensuring requests are clearly defined and include all necessary information (e.g., confirmed budgets, links, assets, requirements). Directs projects to the appropriate team or discipline lead (Content Production, Technology, etc.) who will assign resources accordingly.
Represents the studio holistically during key milestones, including triage and intake meetings, project status meetings, project planning, scoping discussions, and RFP processes.

Execution

Develops project estimates, timelines, and resource plans based on a deep understanding of program management and client partnership trajectories.
Manages the day-to-day workflow of deliverables in alignment with the approved scope of work.
Defines the “how” and “when” of project delivery and empowers teams to meet shared expectations and goals.
Oversees and manages project budgets through regular tracking, reporting, and proactive problem-solving.
Maintains deep knowledge of the creative development process and print production workflows.

Key Competencies

5-8 years of experience in program management, delivery operations, or studio/agency experience
Strategic and inspiring leader
Strong ability to manage multiple clients, projects, and priorities while proactively anticipating issues
Anticipates and resolves issues with a proactive, solution-oriented approach; skilled at de-escalating situations and making confident decisions
Brings hands-on experience in print production
Skilled at fostering strong team morale and creating an environment of open and honest dialogue
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Client-facing professional with broad understanding of studio services
Strong presentation, sales, and marketing capabilities
Keen creative eye for quality control
Team management experience
Ability to operate effectively within an integrated, networked service model

In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

Syneos Health Communications is the only healthcare communications network that is part of a company on the frontlines of healthcare, with a clear view into the everyday complexities of life and health. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Job Title: Anaplan Program Manager

Location: 100% Work from home

Duration: 15 Months Contract with Possible extension

Job Description:

This is a senior program management role focused on Anaplan and enterprise FP&A planning technology
. The person will manage multiple, complex initiatives involving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, finance systems, and planning-platform optimization
.
Seeking an experienced Anaplan Program Manager to lead a portfolio of complex, cross-functional planning technology initiatives.

This role will drive roadmap development, implementation governance, stakeholder alignment, platform optimization, and delivery of solutions that strengthen client’s planning and forecasting capabilities.

Initiatives may include enhancements to Anaplan as well as the evaluation and implementation of complementary or alternative solutions based on evolving business needs.

The program is expected to support a more streamlined planning landscape, reduce model sprawl and duplicated logic, improve governance and maintainability, and create opportunities to centralize business logic and calculations across an integrated planning technology ecosystem. This position reports to the Director, Finance PMO.

Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end delivery of Anaplan and related planning technology initiatives, from discovery and evaluation through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing optimization

Coordinate evaluation of vendor and internal technology options that may complement or extend the current planning ecosystem, including enterprise data and calculation platforms with integrated planning front ends

Drive workstreams to simplify and optimize the current topline planning landscape, reduce model sprawl, improve governance, and enable future-state solution flexibility
Partner with FP&A teams to define scope, business requirements, solution design, and success criteria
Create and maintain an integrated project plan covering scope, milestones, dependencies, RAID items, governance forums, and executive reporting needs
Develop and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across FP&A, Finance, Engineering, data/platform teams, and other business teams
Proactively identify risks, issues, and dependencies; recommend and execute mitigation strategies
Drive governance, decision-making, and escalation through structured forums (e.g., SteerCo, working sessions, etc.)
Support change management, adoption, communications, and enablement activities to help FP&A and business users transition successfully to the future-state planning ecosystem
Apply appropriate project management methodologies (waterfall, agile, hybrid) based on initiative needs

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field

7+ years of project or program management experience, including:

FP&A, planning, forecasting, or management reporting initiatives

Finance systems implementations or enhancements

Business process design or re-engineering in a finance context

Experience managing enterprise planning technology initiatives, including Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, or comparable planning and forecasting platforms
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional programs involving Finance, Engineering, data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders
Experience working with FP&A teams in a technology or software environment
Strong understanding of financial planning cycles, forecasting, and reporting processes
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in complex environments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior leaders
Strong organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail and follow-through

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field
Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or similar certification
Anaplan model-building experience or prior role closely aligned with Anaplan Center of Excellence teams
Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning, including financial planning, workforce planning, or spend planning implementations

Familiarity with Snowflake, Spark, EDH-style data platforms, data integration patterns, or calculation-layer design for finance planning use cases

Experience supporting large-scale finance transformation or FP&A operating model changes
Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments

The Ideal Candidate

Organized:
Works and thinks in a methodical and structured way
Proactive:
Follows up on open items proactively, flags risks and tracks RAID logs to completion
Results-Driven:
Acts proactively to deliver outcomes and close gaps
Strong Communicator:
Clearly translates complex finance and systems concepts for diverse audiences
Influential:
Builds trust and alignment across functions and levels without direct authority
Comfortable with Ambiguity:
Navigates evolving requirements and competing priorities with confidence
Sound Judgment:
Investigates thoroughly to gather relevant information before making decisions
Collaborative:
Partners effectively to achieve shared results across global teams, develops rapport with key stakeholders and internal Finance Transformation members
Resourceful:
Identifies creative paths forward when faced with constraints or limitations

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for a structured and proactive Technical Program Manager to improve how Cloud Support works with Engineering, Product, and other technical teams at Nebius.

Our Support organization helps customers operate complex cloud environments and depends on clear technical ownership, effective escalation paths, strong operational readiness, and the right internal tooling. Your mission is to make these interfaces predictable, well-defined, and scalable.

You will own the technical operating processes around Support, including the escalation framework and support readiness for new products and services. You will stay close to significant incidents, identify when cross-team action is required, and ensure that lessons affecting our processes are translated into concrete improvements. You will also coordinate technical and operational requirements, dependencies, rollout, and enablement for Support tools.

This is a technical program management role. You will work directly with Support engineers, Product, and Engineering on service dependencies, technical ownership, escalation paths, diagnostics, and operational readiness. You should be able to understand technical problems and system interactions deeply enough to identify gaps, challenge incomplete processes, and bring the right technical owners together.

You’re welcome to work from our Amsterdam office or remotely from any location within the EU.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Own and evolve the technical escalation framework between Cloud Support, Engineering, Product, and service owners.
Stay close to significant incidents, surface cross-team risks, and drive resulting process improvements to completion.
Drive Support readiness for new products and services, including ownership, escalation routes, documentation, and team enablement.
Gather technical and operational requirements for Support tools and coordinate dependencies, rollout, and enablement.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how Support works with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams.
Design, document, implement, and maintain processes, procedures, playbooks, templates, and operational documentation.
Identify recurring gaps, define improvements and success metrics, and ensure changes are adopted.

We Expect You To Have

5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, technical delivery, or a related role.
Experience with incident management and technical escalation management.
Strong technical fluency and the ability to understand service architecture, system dependencies, technical ownership, and operational constraints.
Experience working directly with engineering teams to turn technical problems and dependencies into clear actions and process changes.
Proven experience identifying, designing, implementing, and measuring operational process improvements.
Ability to read, understand, and write technical documentation for engineering and operational audiences.
Experience creating and maintaining processes, procedures, playbooks, templates, and operational documentation.
Working knowledge of Jira workflows, automation, dashboards, and reporting, with the ability to configure them when needed.
A proactive approach to identifying problems and driving them through to resolution.
Fluent English.

It Will Be An Added Bonus If You Have

Experience working with cloud infrastructure or large-scale distributed systems.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - RFID Enterprise Capabilities (Hybrid - Seattle, WA)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Since 1901, Nordstrom has been committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences, with a relentless focus on exceeding expectations. As a leading fashion retailer in a digitally connected world, Nordstrom continues to invest in the capabilities that allow us to move faster, operate smarter, and serve customers across both physical and digital channels. Within this context, Inventory Operations plays a critical role in optimizing how we order, place, move, track, and exhaust inventory across the enterprise—acting as a bridge between Merchandising, Supply Chain, and Stores to deliver speed, accuracy, and financial integrity. The Inventory Visibility & Controls (IV&C)
team was established to strengthen enterprise‑wide inventory transparency, traceability, and controls by scaling data, analytics, and foundational capabilities, such as RFID
, enabling proactive decision‑making, preventing loss and unsellable inventory, and increasing confidence in inventory across the full lifecycle.

We are hiring a Senior Program Manager
to support RFID Enterprise Capabilities
within Inventory Visibility & Controls. In this role, you will lead the execution and scaling of RFID as an enterprise inventory integrity platform
—moving it beyond store counting to a foundational capability embedded across supply chain, stores, fulfillment, asset protection, and customer-facing workflows. You will be responsible for translating RFID enterprise strategy into executable programs, ensuring work is well-sequenced, dependencies are actively managed, and cross-functional teams remain aligned as capabilities scale. This includes advancing vendor tagging standards
, driving supplier compliance, and expanding the number of vendors, categories, and flows brought into both RFID scope and program
, while maintaining accuracy and data integrity. This role plays a critical coordination function across Operations, Product, Technology, Stores, Supply Chain, Finance, and Asset Protection—balancing speed, risk, and long-term enterprise value. As RFID continues to mature from episodic accuracy toward continuous, serialized inventory truth, this role ensures standards, governance, adoption, and change management are in place, so new capabilities can deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, shrink, productivity, and customer confidence. This role is ideal for a senior program manager who thrives in complexity, operates comfortably at the intersection of operations and technology, and is motivated by building durable enterprise capabilities that translate strategy into sustained operational impact.

A day in the life…

Own and lead enterprise‑wide RFID programs across the inventory lifecycle, from strategy and roadmap definition through execution, launch, and adoption.
Translate RFID enterprise strategy into executable plans, breaking down large, ambiguous initiatives into sequenced workstreams with clear milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
Lead supplier tagging programs, including defining and evolving tagging specifications and standards, partnering with vendors on onboarding and compliance, and establishing escalation mechanisms to address gaps in data quality or execution.
Oversee RFID coverage and compliance operations, partnering with business and technology teams to triage defects, drive root‑cause resolution, and inform category and vendor expansion strategies as standards mature (including embedded tagging approaches).
Drive delivery of new RFID‑enabled capabilities, including pilots, business‑case validation, and the development of repeatable scale plans in close partnership with Product, Technology, and Operations teams.
Ensure strong program governance and execution discipline, including intake, prioritization, dependency management, risk tracking, and executive‑level status communication across cross‑functional partners.
Partner with data and analytics teams to ensure RFID execution telemetry, compliance reporting, and shrink/support analytics are available through scalable, self‑service tools that reduce manual data work and accelerate decision‑making.
Serve as the primary coordination point across Stores, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Product, Engineering, Finance, Store Technology, and Asset Protection to align priorities and resolve trade‑offs.
Work with external partners, including industry groups (e.g., GS1), academic partners, other retailers, and specialist advisors to inform standards evolution, accelerate learning, and reduce risk.
Anticipate adoption and change‑management needs, ensuring RFID capabilities are supported with clear standards, operational workflows, training, and readiness as they scale.
Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, effectively landing decisions that balance customer experience, operational impact, and financial integrity.
Flex across IV&C initiatives as needed, supporting the highest‑impact enterprise priorities tied to inventory accuracy, shrink reduction, productivity, and customer confidence.

You own this if you have…

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant Master’s degree a plus.
5+ years of experience in program management, product management, management consulting, strategy, or operations, with progressively larger responsibility supporting cross‑functional teams.
Knowledge of RFID and experience in inventory operations, supply chain, store execution, and/or asset protection in a retail environment.
Demonstrated success leading complex, enterprise‑scale programs in ambiguous, fast‑paced environments.
Strong ability to lead through influence, aligning senior stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority.
Experience translating strategy into execution, including roadmap development, sequencing, dependency management, and delivery of measurable outcomes.
Comfort partnering with product, engineering, analytics, and operations teams to deliver technology‑enabled capabilities.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand operational, financial, and risk considerations and incorporate them into program decisions.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive‑level communication skills, with a proven ability to synthesize complexity into clear narratives and decisions.
Highly organized with strong judgment, able to balance competing priorities while maintaining delivery focus.

Bartle Bogle Hegarty (BBH) is a world-famous creative agency that makes jaw-dropping, thumb-stopping, eye-opening work for brands across the globe. Founded in London in 1982, we now have offices in New York, Los Angeles, Stockholm, Mumbai, Singapore, and Shanghai. Our first ad for Levi’s showed a black sheep travelling in the opposite direction to a flock of white ones. That’s where we got our logo and our guiding philosophy: when the world zigs, zag. Why? Because it’s easy to zig, to go with the grain. It feels safe. It feels like the sensible thing to do. But the greater risk is failing to stand out. We believe in the power of difference to make a difference.

Our goal is a simple one: make the best work in the world. That’s where you come in. We need rebels, dreamers, thinkers, mathematicians, makers, artists, visionaries, doers, observers, the different and the unreasonable. We need Black Sheep. People who want to make the hearts flutter and minds do flips, who can change businesses and culture. People who want to make a difference, come here for something different.

https://www.bartleboglehegarty.com

jobs.title: Hardware Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Efficient is developing the world’s most energy-efficient general-purpose computer processor. Efficient’s patented technology uses 100x less energy than state of the art commercially available ultra-low-power processors and is programmable using standard high-level programming languages and AI/ML frameworks. This level of efficiency makes perpetual, pervasive intelligence possible: run AI/ML continuously on a AA battery for 5-10 years. Our platform’s unprecedented level of efficiency enables IoT devices to intelligently capture and curate first-party data to drive the next major computing revolution

We are looking for a Hardware Technical Program Manager
to own the program end-to-end — from architecture freeze through RTL, verification, physical implementation, tapeout, bring-up, and production release.

You will be the operational center of the program: building and defending the schedule, driving the critical path, surfacing risk early, and making the tradeoff conversations happen before they become slips. You'll work daily with architecture, RTL design, DV/emulation, DFT, physical design, package, firmware, and the foundry/IP vendor ecosystem. Join our team and help us shape the future of computing at the edge and beyond!

Key Responsibilities

Own the Program

Own the silicon schedule from architecture freeze through tapeout, bring-up, and production with the schedule informed by customer requirements and internal functional leads.
Drive the weekly execution cadence (program reviews, design reviews, tapeout readiness) and maintain a single source of truth for status, dependencies, and decisions.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Coordinate handoffs across architecture, RTL, DV/emulation, DFT, physical design, IP, package, and software
Manage the dependency chains hardware programs live and die on: IP delivery, PDK/library releases, EDA versions, and emulation capacity.
Run the tapeout checklist and signoff matrix (timing, power, IR/EM, DRC/LVS, DFT coverage, ECO closure, GDS handoff), holding owners to closure criteria.
Work with supply chain/logistics for: IP acquisition, silicon arrival, ATE/loadboard readiness, lab scheduling, bug triage, and ECO/respin decision support.

Manage Risk & Decisions

Surface risk early with mitigation options and schedule impact quantified — late IP, coverage shortfalls, convergence misses, foundry slot changes.
Facilitate PPA, schedule, and scope tradeoffs, and document what was decided, by whom, and why.

Coordinate Externally & Report Up

Interface with foundry, OSAT, IP, and EDA partners on deliverables, technology file releases, mask slots, and escalations; support export control/ECCN compliance with legal and operations.
Deliver crisp executive reporting — where the program stands, what's at risk, what decision is needed and by when — across distributed teams and time zones.
Track resource allocation and NRE/mask/license/prototype budgets against program needs.

Required Qualifications

B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. or MBA a plus.
7+ years in semiconductor/hardware engineering or program management, including at least 2 full SoC/ASIC programs taken from concept through tapeout and silicon bring-up.
Working fluency in the chip design flow: RTL, functional verification and coverage closure, DFT, synthesis, PnR, STA, physical signoff (DRC/LVS/IR/EM), GDSII handoff, and post-silicon validation.
Demonstrated ability to build and defend a bottoms-up schedule with critical path analysis and dependency mapping.
Track record influencing without authority — earning the technical credibility to push senior engineers on commitments and dates.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to run a room of principal engineers and an exec review with equal effectiveness.
Hands-on with program tooling: Jira, Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, and familiarity with the Synopsys/Cadence/Siemens EDA ecosystem.

Desired Qualifications & Experience Requirements

Prior hands-on engineering experience in design, DV, or physical design before moving to program management.
Experience on advanced or FinFET nodes (16/12/7nm or more advanced) and direct foundry engagement (TSMC preferred).
Familiarity with AI/ML accelerators, dataflow or novel compute architectures..
Experience managing emulation/FPGA prototyping programs and pre-silicon software enablement timelines.
Exposure to package/board co-design programs (FC-BGA, WLCSP) and OSAT coordination.
Experience with EVK/reference board programs and customer/FAE enablement schedules.
Familiarity with quality and compliance frameworks relevant to the target market (automotive, industrial, or security certifications).

We offer a competitive salary for this role, generally ranging from $200,000 to $240,000, along with bonus, meaningful equity and comprehensive benefits. The final compensation package will be based on your experience and location, with some flexibility to ensure we align with the right candidate.

Why Join Efficient?

Efficient offers a competitive compensation and benefits package
, including 401K match, company-paid benefits, equity program, paid parental leave, and flexibility
. We are committed to personal and professional development and strive to grow together as people and as a company.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Themed Experiences
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on? Roku’s Viewer Product team owns the ever-evolving end-to-end experience for the 100+ million households that use Roku every day. We design, build, and optimize everything they see—from the Roku Home Screen, Live TV Guide, and Sports Zone to the Roku Channel app on and off-platform—and power it all with our Consumer-AI personalization engine, which is also used for these experiences, as well as the billions of searches performed. Our global, cross-functional squad of product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers spans San Jose, New York, Santa Monica, Austin, Boston, the UK, Mexico, and India. Our mission is to connect 400 million viewers worldwide to their favorite entertainment through something that is simple and delightful.

What is the role? Roku is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Themed Experiences to join the Viewer Product team and help bring to life a new, high-visibility surface on the Roku Home Screen. This is a highly visible, leadership-level program.
This role will drive the program toward launch, coordinating across engineering, product management, advertising, personalization, and creative teams to deliver a differentiated Roku experience.
The Senior Program Manager will build and maintain program structure, manage cross-functional dependencies spanning multiple time zones, and ensure the team hits critical milestones on an ambitious timeline. This person will also partner with stakeholders to develop tooling and scheduling workflows for content creators, enabling a sustainable and scalable production process. The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader who thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, earns trust through decisive action, and brings recommendations on AI-driven automations and methodologies to optimize program execution.
For California, New York, and Massachusetts - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $280,000 - $310,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI; we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.
We value curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role? Drive end-to-end program management for a new home screen experience from development through launch and ongoing operations
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across product, engineering, design, advertising, personalization, and creative teams
Build and maintain detailed program plans, timelines, and dependency maps across globally distributed teams spanning multiple time zones
Establish and run program governance including status reporting, risk identification, escalation paths, and decision-making frameworks
Partner with product management to translate vision into actionable milestones and deliverables
Develop tooling requirements and scheduling workflows for content creators to enable scalable production
Drive alignment across senior stakeholders, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and priorities
Identify and implement process improvements, including AI-powered automations and methodologies, to accelerate program delivery
Manage competing priorities and make timely trade-off decisions to keep the program on track
Leverage project management tools such as Jira, Jira Product Discovery, and Asana to maintain program visibility and accountability

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 10+ years of program management experience in technology, media, entertainment, or consumer products
Demonstrated success managing
Experience driving programs from concept through launch in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Strong ability to earn trust and influence without direct authority across engineering, product, design, and creative teams
Proficiency with project management and product discovery tools such as Jira, Asana, and similar platforms
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to synthesize information for diverse audiences
Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones
Familiarity with consumer-facing product development, home screen or platform experiences, or content-driven product surfaces
Track record of identifying and implementing process efficiencies, including the use of AI tools and automation
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Program Manager, Information Security
jobs.description:
About Our Group

The Information Security organization is responsible for protecting Seagate's global technology environment and enabling secure, resilient business operations. Within Information Security, Governance & Risk Management establishes the planning, risk, governance, and management disciplines that help translate cybersecurity priorities into coordinated and measurable execution aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

The team works across Information Security, IT, business functions, and external partners to provide consistent governance, visibility, and accountability for cybersecurity initiatives and outcomes.

About The Role - You Will

The Program Manager, Information Security supports the planning, governance, reporting, and execution discipline for the Information Security portfolio. The role helps provide clear visibility into priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and outcomes so security leaders can manage initiatives with consistency and accountability.

This role requires project management experience in a cybersecurity or Information Security environment, with enough security context to understand program risks, dependencies, controls, and stakeholder needs while working closely with technical security teams.

Manage Information Security projects and programs from planning through execution and closure, ensuring clear scope, ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.
Establish consistent portfolio governance and project-management practices across Information Security initiatives.
Partner with security leaders to translate Information Security priorities into executable plans and maintain an integrated portfolio roadmap.
Facilitate portfolio reviews, operating reviews, project governance forums, and cross-functional working sessions; drive decisions, actions, and follow-through.
Identify delivery risks, resource constraints, cross-project dependencies, and competing priorities; escalate issues when leadership decisions or trade-offs are required.
Develop and maintain Information Security dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, project health indicators, RAID logs, decision logs, and portfolio reporting.
Consolidate information from security teams into concise executive-level reporting that highlights progress, outcomes, risks, trends, trade-offs, and decisions required, while keeping technical delivery accountability with the responsible security teams.
Support portfolio intake, planning, prioritization, budgeting, forecasting, and resource-planning activities for the Information Security portfolio.
Coordinate major initiatives involving Information Security, IT, business functions, vendors, and managed service providers.
Drive continuous improvement in project governance, reporting, operating cadence, and automation to improve execution discipline and reduce administrative overhead.
This is an individual contributor role and does not have people management responsibilities.

About You

The right individual for this role is organized, analytical, and execution-oriented, with the ability to bring structure to complex technical initiatives and drive accountability across teams without direct authority. You are comfortable working with cybersecurity leaders and technical teams while translating detailed program information into clear, concise communication for senior leadership.

You focus on outcomes, accountability, and measurable progress rather than activity alone.
You can work across multiple initiatives and stakeholders while maintaining a clear view of priorities and dependencies.
You are data driven and able to turn operational and project information into actionable metrics and executive insights.
You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and surface risks or decisions early.

Responsibilities

The activities covered by the Program Manager can be grouped into the following areas:

Program and portfolio governance

Maintain the integrated Information Security portfolio, roadmap, delivery plans, intake process, and governance calendar.
Help align portfolio planning, reporting, and governance activities to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, including appropriate visibility across Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover, and Govern functions.
Define and apply consistent methods for status reporting, risk and issue management, RAID tracking, dependency tracking, change control, decision logging, and action-item follow-up.
Track commitments and milestones across security initiatives and ensure owners provide timely updates and corrective actions where required.

Metrics and performance management

Coordinate the collection, validation, and presentation of security program metrics, KPIs, KRIs, and delivery performance indicators.
Create and improve dashboards that provide actionable visibility into project status, remediation progress, control implementation, risk reduction, and other measures of program effectiveness.
Work with functional leaders to improve metric definitions, consistency, data quality, and reporting cadence while keeping accountability for the underlying outcomes with the responsible security teams.

Executive and leadership reporting

Prepare clear and concise materials for Information Security leadership, the CIO, and other leadership forums.
Synthesize complex project, risk, and performance information into leadership-level views of accomplishments, trends, constraints, and decisions required.
Maintain an operating rhythm that connects strategic priorities, portfolio execution, metrics, and leadership decisions.

Your Experience Includes

5+ years of experience in program management, project management, PMO, portfolio management, or a related role within cybersecurity, Information Security, or a closely related technical security environment.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and controlling, and closure.
Demonstrated experience establishing project governance, tracking dependencies and risks, and driving cross-functional execution without direct authority.
Experience developing KPIs, KRIs, dashboards, status reporting, project health views, and executive-level presentations or management reporting.
Working knowledge of common Information Security domains and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, including areas such as governance, risk, compliance, identity and access management, security operations, vulnerability management, cloud security, endpoint security, data protection, or application security.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, delivery risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate detailed technical or project information into concise leadership-level messages.
Experience working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple functions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Information Security programs across areas such as security risk, governance, architecture, engineering, security operations, compliance, operational technology, or third-party security.
Experience with portfolio, reporting, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Power BI, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, or similar platforms.
Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, especially the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, security controls, risk-management concepts, and common governance or compliance requirements.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $132,974.00 - $193,816.00. The individual salary is based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The benefits for this position are based on a full-time schedule for a full calendar year and may differ depending on work location.

And we have a lot of fun together.

About The Role:

The Director, Program Management is the connective tissue between PayIt's executive leadership, client executives, and the implementation, product, and engineering teams delivering for PayIt Outdoors clients. This person keeps the delivery engine running: an organized, predictable, and transparent way of shipping commitments across a portfolio of concurrent state agency engagements. They are equally comfortable in a steering committee with a state agency director and in a working session with an implementation lead debugging a launch blocker – and they know when each posture is needed.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely strategic one. The right person builds and runs the cadences, reporting, and governance that make a multi-client delivery portfolio predictable, while personally stepping in on the accounts and escalations that need it most.

What You'll Do:

Executive & Client Relationship Management

Serve as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for PayIt Outdoors clients, building relationships with state agency executives and program sponsors.
Represent delivery status, risk, and roadmap in executive business reviews – both with clients and with PayIt's leadership team.
Translate between client priorities and internal delivery capacity, setting realistic expectations and holding the line on scope, timeline, and quality.

Cross-Functional Delivery Orchestration

Own end-to-end coordination across implementation, product, and engineering teams for every active PayIt Outdoors client engagement.
Identify dependencies and conflicts across the client portfolio early – shared engineering capacity, competing launch dates, overlapping resources – and resolve or escalate them before they become blockers.
Partner with product and engineering leadership to align the delivery roadmap with what has been committed to clients, and flag gaps in both directions.

Program Governance & the Delivery Engine

Design and run the operating cadence for the Outdoors delivery organization: status cycles, steering committees, risk reviews, and launch readiness gates.
Build and maintain a consistent, repeatable program management framework (RAID logs, status taxonomy, escalation paths, definitions of "on track," "at risk," and "red") so every account is tracked the same way.
Continuously improve the delivery process based on what breaks – turning one-off fire drills into permanent process fixes.
Develop a project reporting framework suitable for hybrid SaaS solutions that can be efficiently replicated across projects.

Reporting & Communication

Produce client-facing status reports and executive readouts that are accurate, timely, and honest about risk.
Build and maintain internal reporting (portfolio dashboards, delivery scorecards) that gives PayIt executives a real-time, trustworthy view of the entire Outdoors book of business.
Ensure reporting flows both ways: client-facing commitments are visible internally, and internal capacity/risk is reflected in what clients are told.

Risk & Issue Management

Maintain a live view of risk across the portfolio and drive mitigation plans, not just risk logs.
Lead root-cause reviews after missed dates or escalations, and ensure fixes stick.

Team Leadership

Mentor and, as the portfolio grows, manage a team of program and project managers; set the standard for how they run their accounts.
Hire, coach, and develop program management talent to keep pace with the growth of the Outdoors business.

What You’ll Bring:

8–12+ years of program or project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent, complex, client-facing implementations simultaneously.
Demonstrated ability to operate credibly with C-suite/executive stakeholders and with day-to-day project teams – you can run a steering committee and a stand-up in the same day.
A track record of building (not just following) delivery governance: reporting structures, status cadences, escalation frameworks, and portfolio-level visibility.
Experience working across product and engineering organizations, with enough technical fluency to understand delivery risk without needing it translated.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can turn a messy delivery reality into a clear, confidence-building narrative for a client executive or a PayIt SVP.
A bias toward organization and follow-through – things don't fall through the cracks on your accounts.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; PMP, PgMP, or similar certification required.

Bonus Points For:

Experience with state or local government clients, GovTech, or regulated public-sector procurement and delivery environments.
Experience with outdoor recreation, licensing, permitting, DMV, or similar agency systems.
Experience scaling a PMO or delivery function through a period of client/portfolio growth.
Familiarity with delivery and reporting tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Confluence, and BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Why Work For Us:

Our mission matters. Your work will make life better for our government agency clients and the millions of residents they serve.
You’ll do some of the best work of your career here. We tackle complex challenges that are interesting to solve, and you’ll grow a ton working at PayIt
People are our most important resource. Everyone has a voice. Collaboration is our default setting. And we have fun together.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Objetivo del Cargo

Asegurar el control integral del portafolio de proyectos de Fugro Chile, resguardando el cumplimiento de los compromisos de alcance, plazo, costo, calidad y seguridad. El rol desarrolla y controla los cronogramas y presupuestos de los proyectos en ejecución, verifica la información de avance, administra KPIs y costos, y emite alertas tempranas documentadas —con impacto cuantificado en plazo y costo y opciones de acción— que permitan corregir el rumbo de los proyectos antes de que la desviación se materialice.

El cargo depende jerárquica y funcionalmente del Gerente de Proyectos y Operaciones. Su función de control es independiente de la línea de ejecución reporta la situación real del proyecto aun cuando difiera de la posición del Project Manager, resguardando la objetividad de la información que sustenta las decisiones de la Gerencia.

Asimismo, garantiza la correcta aplicación de los procedimientos corporativos, la gestión de riesgos, la calidad y la mejora continua, sin que ninguna acción de recuperación de plazo o costo comprometa los estándares de seguridad.

Responsabilidades

Planificación y Programación

Desarrollar el Plan Maestro del Proyecto (línea base de alcance, plazo y costo) y mantenerlo vigente, gestionando formalmente todo cambio de línea base. Construir y mantener WBS, rutas críticas, secuencias lógicas y flotación en Primavera P6 o MS Project, con calendarios que reflejen las condiciones reales de faena. Incorporar en la programación los tiempos efectivos de la operación minera acreditación e inducciones, charlas y análisis de riesgo, permisos de trabajo, bloqueos, ventanas de tronadura, cambios de turno, interferencias operacionales y condiciones climáticas y de altura geográfica. Validar el plan de ejecución junto a Operaciones, Ingeniería, HSE y Logística antes de su congelamiento. Integrar la información multiproyecto en un portafolio consolidado para reportabilidad interna y regional.

Control de Proyectos

Controlar avance físico y financiero, generando informes semanales, de tres semanas y mensuales. Verificar el avance declarado mediante evidencia objetiva o revisión en terreno, sin limitarse a consolidar lo informado por el proyecto. Realizar análisis de desviaciones, curvas S, tendencias y proyecciones (Forecast / EAC). Implementar y reportar Earned Value Management (EVM), incluyendo SPI, CPI y sus tendencias. Preparar y actualizar presupuestos, precios unitarios y análisis referenciales para licitaciones, incorporando los rendimientos reales de los proyectos ejecutados.

Sistema de Alerta Temprana

Definir y monitorear indicadores adelantados productividad real vs. comprometida, consumo de flotación en actividades críticas, horas-hombre incurridas vs. ganadas, avance de ingeniería y permisos, disponibilidad de equipos y cumplimiento de ventanas operacionales. Emitir Alerta Temprana formal al superarse los umbrales definidos (referencia SPI o CPI inferior a 0,95; consumo superior al 50% de la flotación en una actividad crítica; desviación proyectada del EAC mayor a 5%; tendencia negativa en dos períodos consecutivos), indicando causa, impacto cuantificado en plazo y costo, y opciones de recuperación con sus riesgos asociados. Conducir el proceso de trisemanal con compromisos por responsable, medición del cumplimiento del programa (PPC) y liberación anticipada de restricciones. Escalar las alertas al Gerente de Proyectos y Operaciones dentro del plazo establecido en la matriz de escalamiento, con independencia de la posición del Project Manager. Mantener la trazabilidad de las alertas emitidas y del cierre de las acciones comprometidas.

Gestión de Riesgos, Cambios y Contratos

Gestionar la matriz de riesgos y cuantificar su impacto en plazo y costo, proponiendo planes de mitigación con responsable y fecha, y haciendo seguimiento a su cumplimiento. Administrar órdenes de cambio
y variaciones contractuales, asegurando su notificación dentro de los plazos que establece el contrato. Preparar y sustentar reclamos de plazo y costo (EOT / claims)
con registro contemporáneo y análisis de impacto en programa (as-planned vs. as-built / time impact analysis). Monitorear compromisos contractuales, hitos de pago y criterios de cumplimiento, alertando anticipadamente sobre riesgos de incumplimiento, descuentos o multas. Coordinar reuniones de control y seguimiento con contratistas, consultores y partners técnicos, y actuar como contraparte técnica de sus entregables. Emitir reportes consolidados del portafolio para Project Managers, PMO y Gerencia.

Seguridad, Calidad y Mejora Continua

Asegurar que ninguna medida de recuperación de programa comprometa los controles críticos de seguridad; toda opción de aceleración debe declarar explícitamente su impacto en seguridad antes de ser presentada a decisión. Reportar los indicadores HSE
del proyecto junto a los de plazo y costo, y participar en la revisión de los riesgos operacionales asociados a la planificación. Levantar no conformidades y desviaciones de proceso, aplicar análisis de causa raíz
y hacer seguimiento de las acciones correctivas hasta verificar su eficacia. Mantener indicadores de calidad del delivery retrabajo, entregables rechazados por el cliente, oportunidad de emisión de informes y exactitud del forecast. Contribuir a la implementación y actualización del Sistema de Gestión Integrado de Project Delivery
y asegurar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos corporativos. Proponer mejoras a herramientas, estándares y procesos de control de proyectos, traduciendo las lecciones aprendidas en cambios concretos a plantillas, estándares y estimaciones base.

Cierre y Capitalización de la Experiencia

Participar en el cierre técnico, administrativo y financiero de los proyectos, incluyendo la liquidación de cambios y reclamos pendientes. Documentar lecciones aprendidas con datos de respaldo (rendimientos reales y causas de desviación) y transferirlas a la etapa de estimación. Consolidar los rendimientos históricos del portafolio como base de referencia para futuras ofertas. Apoyar la transferencia de mejores prácticas entre proyectos y equipos.

Formación Académica

Título profesional en Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Civil en Minas, Construcción Civil o profesión afín.

Experiencia

Mínimo 6 años en gestión de proyectos en minería, geotecnia, infraestructura o ingeniería, de los cuales al menos 3 años en proyectos de la gran minería ejecutados en faena y bajo estándares de cliente minero.
Experiencia comprobable en administración contractual de servicios estados de pago, órdenes de cambio, notificaciones dentro de plazo y preparación de reclamos de plazo y costo con su respaldo documental.
Experiencia en relación directa con el cliente y con equipos en terreno, incluyendo manejo de discrepancias y resolución de conflictos a nivel contractual.

Conocimientos

Gestión de portafolio multiproyecto y soporte directo a Project Managers.
Primavera P6 (excluyente cuando el contrato con el cliente lo exija) y/o Microsoft Project.
Earned Value Management (EVM), curvas S, análisis de tendencias y proyecciones (EAC/ETC).
Excel avanzado y Power BI, con capacidad de construir el modelo de datos y no solo el reporte.
Administración contractual suma alzada, serie de precios unitarios.
Gestión de riesgos y metodologías de análisis de causa raíz.
Normativa y estándares de seguridad aplicables a faenas mineras.
Inglés nivel B2 (intermedio-avanzado).

Otros

Certificación en gestión de proyectos PMP, PMI-SP o AACE (PSP / EVP).
Formación en administración de contratos, claims o gestión de reclamos.
Conocimiento de ISO 9001 y sistemas de gestión integrados.
Experiencia previa en empresas de servicios geotécnicos, geofísicos o de sondajes.
Licencia de conducir clase B vigente (deseable para visitas a faena).

Aspectos Deseables

Salud compatible con trabajos en terreno y altura geográfica, según los exámenes preocupacionales que apliquen.
Acreditación de faena e inducciones del cliente vigentes, o posibilidad de obtenerlas.
Licencia interna de conducción en faena cuando el proyecto lo requiera.
