Technology delivery and planning
Lead and manage multiple concurrent technology and business initiatives of varying size and complexity using SFA’s hybrid delivery approach.
Manage initiatives involving data integration, analytics, reporting, and system integrations.
Work with business and Technology stakeholders to clarify objectives, scope, outcomes, assumptions, success measures, and decision rights.
Develop and maintain integrated plans covering milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, critical path, design, development, testing, approvals, implementation, and transition to operations.
Drive work forward with limited day-to-day direction and escalate when decisions, resources, or leadership intervention are needed.

Requirements, scope, and solution alignment
Facilitate discovery and requirements discussions across business, technology, UX and design, content, data, finance, security, and vendor teams.
Ensure business requirements are sufficiently understood before work advances, including possible integration, data, customer experience, security, operational, accessibility, and downstream process impacts.
Maintain traceability from approved requirements and decisions to deliverables, tasks, designs, testing, and acceptance criteria.
Proactively identify ambiguity, gaps, conflicting assumptions, and scope changes and drive resolution with the appropriate stakeholders.
Distinguish projects from enhancements, production support, and operational work and support consistent intake and governance practices.

Digital experience, UX, and design delivery
Plan and manage the UX and design lifecycle.
Ensure approved requirements and decisions are documented and traceable.
Identify design decisions or changes that may affect scope, integrations, content migration, development effort, timeline, budget, testing, or operations.

Execution, risk, and dependency management
Own day-to-day execution, including assignments, due dates, estimates, status, follow-up, issue resolution.
Maintain current risk, issue, decision, action, and dependency tracking with clear owners, impacts, mitigation actions, and escalation paths.
Validate that dates are realistic commitments rather than placeholders.
Be resourceful when faced with challenges and proactively find solutions with the project team.
Coordinate shared resources across initiatives and surface conflicts early so priorities and sequencing can be resolved.
Plan and coordinate testing, deployment, communications, and post-launch follow-up as appropriate.

Stakeholder and vendor management
Lead meetings with clear objectives, agendas, decisions needed, and follow-up actions.
Hold internal teams and vendors accountable for commitments.
Manage deliverables, timelines, dependencies, open questions, and approvals in coordination with project and business owners.
Exercise judgment about when to resolve issues directly, convene stakeholders, or escalate.

Communication, documentation, and reporting
Produce clear, accurate meeting notes, status reports, decision summaries, and closeout communications.
Ensure communications identify accomplishments, next steps, risks, dependencies, impacts, owners, dates, and decisions needed.
Capture decisions and action items accurately and confirm alignment when discussions are complex or information is incomplete.
Maintain organized, current records in Asana and approved repositories so stakeholders can locate authoritative information.
Prepare concise project delivery updates that support prioritization, governance, and leadership decisions.

Bachelor’s degree.

Proficiency with Asana, Smartsheet (or comparable project management platform) and Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Core Competencies
Independent technology delivery management and ownership
Critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous situations
Accountability, follow-through, and attention to detail
Adaptability across multiple priorities and working styles
Strong facilitation, judgment, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Airside
new_jobs.description:
TYLin
is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager, Airside to provide design leadership on some of the largest and most complex airport redevelopment programs in North America. This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished aviation professional to lead multidisciplinary design teams, manage key stakeholder relationships, and help deliver world-class airside facilities to shape the long-term development of aviation infrastructure.

We are looking for an exceptional design leader with extensive experience managing the design of major airside projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will bring a proven ability to lead complex multidisciplinary teams while collaborating closely with airport owners, general contractors, design consultants, airlines, and other project stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of large capital programs.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Airside to lead the planning, design, and delivery of complex airfield/airside projects for major aviation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to join a globally recognized aviation practice and contribute to the transformation of some of the world’s most important airport facilities.

We are looking for a project manager with a strong background in airside/airfield design and redevelopment, who has successfully led multidisciplinary design teams on major projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will have experience coordinating architects, engineers, planners, specialty consultants, airport stakeholders, airlines, and operational teams to deliver innovative, functional, and passenger-focused terminal environments.

Responsibilities

Lead the design delivery of major airfield projects for commercial, regional, and general aviation airports.
Manage multidisciplinary design teams including architects, engineers, planners, aviation specialists, and specialty consultants.
Coordinate all phases of airside design, including programming, concept design, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, and construction administration.
Develop and manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, and delivery strategies.
Facilitate design coordination meetings and ensure alignment between architectural, engineering, operational, and stakeholder requirements.
Review and manage design deliverables, technical submissions, and quality assurance processes.
Coordinate with construction teams to support constructability reviews, phasing strategies, and implementation planning.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain design quality, schedule, and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Airfield Planning, Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience delivering complex airside/airfield design projects.
Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams on complex aviation projects.
Strong understanding of airfield planning, architectural design, operational requirements, and airfield layouts.
Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience coordinating with airport authorities, airlines, tenants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.

Preferred

Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience delivering projects for the Port Authority of New York & New Jersey (PANYNJ).
Experience on large hub airport redevelopment programs valued in the hundreds of millions or billions of dollars.
Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CMAR, or Public-Private Partnership (P3) delivery models.
PMP certification is considered an asset.

Typical Project Experience

The ideal candidate will have led the design and coordination of projects such as:

Airfield layouts
Aircraft parking layout design
Airport Master Plans
Facility requirement analyses
Capacity and operational studies
Phasing and development plans

Ideal Candidate

You are a collaborative design leader with a passion for aviation infrastructure and a reputation for delivering technically complex airport projects. You excel at bringing together diverse teams, resolving competing priorities, and fostering strong partnerships between clients, contractors, and consultants.

You understand that successful airport projects require more than technical expertise—they demand proactive communication, strategic thinking, and the ability to align multiple stakeholders around a shared vision. Your experience leading large-scale terminal programs has equipped you to confidently navigate the challenges of delivering projects in operational airports while maintaining the highest standards of design quality, safety, and project performance.

Why TYLin?

TYLin is a global leader in aviation planning, architecture, engineering, and program management. We partner with airport owners to deliver innovative, sustainable, and resilient infrastructure that enhances passenger experience and supports long-term operational success.

Joining our Aviation practice means you'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the design of landmark airport projects.
Collaborate with internationally recognized aviation experts across multiple disciplines.
Influence the delivery of some of North America's most significant airport capital programs.
Grow your career within a collaborative, employee-focused organization committed to technical excellence and innovation.
Receive a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

Join Us

If you are an experienced aviation design leader with a proven track record of delivering major airport terminal projects and building trusted relationships with clients, contractors, and consultant teams, we invite you to join TYLin.

Help shape the next generation of airport terminals by leading designs that are innovative, operationally efficient, and centered on the passenger experience.

Additional Information

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $153,600 - $210,600 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. TYLin is proud to offer exciting career development opportunities.

TYLin
offers a comprehensive total rewards package. Our benefits may include extensive medical, disability and life insurance coverage, continuing education benefits, paid time off, employee assistance program and a retirement savings plan with company matching contributions.

We encourage all candidates to explore our total rewards offering.

Collaboration, mission-driven focus, discipline, and leadership skills developed through military service benefit us all. Whether you are a Veteran, Guardsman or Reservist, a Military Spouse or you are planning to transition to civilian life in the near future, we welcome and value your application.

TYLin
is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type as protected by federal, provincial, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The company and its employees are required to comply with all local health authority, legal or lawful client requirements.
